# SAIKO

> SAIKO is an anime discovery application for exploring anime, reading news, watching trailers, and finding recommendations based on your taste.

Browse and search the public anime catalog without an account. Onboarding lets
you choose three favorite anime. Sign in to save favorites, discover your Anime
DNA, and access personalized recommendations. Users can share their Anime DNA
through public profile links.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://saiko-app.pxxl.click/): Featured discoveries and trending anime.
- [Anime](https://saiko-app.pxxl.click/anime): Browse the anime catalog and open individual titles for details.
- [Search](https://saiko-app.pxxl.click/search): Search for anime by title.
- [News](https://saiko-app.pxxl.click/news): Anime news with links to original sources.
- [Trailers](https://saiko-app.pxxl.click/trailers): Official YouTube anime trailers.
- [Onboarding](https://saiko-app.pxxl.click/onboarding): Choose three anime that define your taste.

## Account features

- [Sign in](https://saiko-app.pxxl.click/auth): Sign in or create an account to save favorites.
- [Recommendations](https://saiko-app.pxxl.click/recommendations): Personalized anime discoveries; requires sign-in and completed onboarding.
- [Anime DNA](https://saiko-app.pxxl.click/anime-dna): Discover and share your anime taste profile; requires sign-in and completed onboarding.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://saiko-app.pxxl.click/sitemap.xml): Public navigation pages.
- [Crawler policy](https://saiko-app.pxxl.click/robots.txt): Crawl permissions and content-use signals.
